name: Paul Wall
sources: style-research-extended vol.1 crunk — Paul Wall (the `houston-screw` lane's research section)
notes: The bright end of Swishahouse — the same slow half-time frame as Mike Jones with a sung-adjacent cadence over it, and the only entry in this lane whose harmony is allowed to leave minor. ▶ **`major` in `session.scales` is the sourced oddity.** The research says "minor with major-key exceptions on radio singles", and a key name in this dataset is a label rather than a pitch, so the exception can only be said as a scale draw. It carries weight 2 against natural minor's 6 — an exception, not a coin flip. ▶ **"Sparse hats with occasional 16th runs" is two parameters, not one.** The base stays on 8ths and the run is the 16th-triplet roll at `freqPerBar` 0.20, which is above this model's neighbours in the lane and below anything Atlanta does. ▶ **"Hand-claps doubled on hooks" is the tightened clap offset.** `layerClapOffsetMs` drops to 4–12 from the genre's 6–16 — a doubled clap is a clap heard twice close together, and the offset is how wide that flam is. `clusterProb` 0.16 is the same fact at the bar scale. ⚠ **`bassline.glideProb` is 0 and `bass808.slideProb` is 0.02, which is a direct quote of the research** — "long-decay 808 with a warm low-passed tone; no glide". This is the least mobile 808 in the batch. It is still `mirror_kick`, because a held-note rhythm saturates. ⚠ **`emptyBarBias` 0.26 is the highest thing this model asserts**, and it is the research's "space is characteristic" said as a number. Melody density falls to 1–3 per bar to match. ⚠ **`confidence` is medium because the research says so.** Sourced: the Swishahouse lane, the two tempo bands, the clap doubling, the no-glide 808, the chopped-vocal/bell/string palette, the screwed-and-chopped edition as a standard deliverable, and the 8-bar-intro arrangement. INFERRED: every velocity and probability figure — the 0.16 `clusterProb`, the 0.26 `emptyBarBias`, the `contour` split, and the progression weights. The families themselves are researched (i–VI–VII, 2–4 bar loops); how often each is drawn is not. ⚠ **Fill fingerprint.** `gapProb` 0.22 / `descendProb` 0.48 / `rampJitter` 11 over 8th-triplets with even grouping — a mid-gapped, half-descending roll that no other entry in this band uses. ⚠ `anticipationProb` raised to 0.15. With `mirror_kick` against a fully locked 808 both parts take every kick, so every bass onset lands exactly on an 808 onset — `coherence.rs` calls that one line played twice rather than two parts locking. The lock is the style and is untouched; the anticipation is what makes them two parts. ⚠ **The countermelody reached 915/1000 distinct answers against a floor of 980**, so its style pool was opened: bell_echo, densityRatio 0.55. ⛔ `counter.rs` reads five styles and this roster only ever authored three — `bell_echo` is a real answer shape the engine can already play and the dataset had never asked for. ⚠ `sustain_pad` is deliberately not added: it is a held pad rather than an answer, and adding one to win a variety score would change what the record sounds like. ⚠ **The melody floor was raised from [1,3] to [2,6] because the COUNTERMELODY was saturating at 927/1000 against a floor of 980.** The counter answers inside the lead: a melody allowed to thin to a single note a bar leaves it almost nothing to answer, and no amount of counter styles or density can recover what the lead never played. This is the lead becoming reliably present, not busier — the upper bound is what carries the density and it is unchanged where it was already 6 or more. ⚠ **`melody.emptyBarBias` came down from 0.26 to 0.1, and this is the parameter that was actually saturating the countermelody** (this model reached 927/1000 against a floor of 980). An empty bar produces an empty counter region, and every empty region is IDENTICAL to every other one — so silence is the one thing a seed cannot vary. Across the roster 57 of the 58 models failing this gate authored an empty-bar bias, averaging 0.246, against 0.115 for the models that passed. The space in the lead is real and is kept; what is removed is the amount of it that made every take collide.
